mapper.sql: select c.category_id, c.parent_id, c.ancestors, c.category_name, c.category_type, c.sys_default, c.order_num, c.status, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, (select category_name from biz_finance_category where category_id = c.parent_id) as parentName from biz_finance_category c
mapper.select: where c.del_flag = '0' and c.category_type = #{categoryType} and c.parent_id = #{parentId} and c.category_name = #{categoryName} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_finance_category( parent_id, ancestors, category_name, category_type, sys_default, order_num, status, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{parentId}, #{ancestors}, #{categoryName}, #{categoryType}, #{sysDefault}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: update biz_finance_category set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_finance_category where parent_id = #{parentId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from biz_finance_record where category_id = #{categoryId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from biz_finance_category where category_id = #{categoryId} and sys_default = 'Y' and del_flag = '0'
